snippet.title: Ankh - Curse of the Scarab King (Nintendo DS) - Trailer
snippet.description:
The official English trailer for Ankh - Curse of the Scarab King for Nintendo DS.

This comical adventure game lets players hold the scorching streets of Cairo in the palm of their hands as they guide Assil on a quest to lift a deadly curse.

Following the success of the popular PC versions, the fun and colourful adventure Ankh: Curse of the Scarab King  will be available to play on DS from 14th November 2008.

www.ankh-game.com
